name: Mare Voss
presence: Mare Voss runs the center table from a wheelchair armored in road signs. She misses nothing, including you.
greeting: Scrip on the table, hands where you can invoice them. Ask what they want.

ash.gist: If they are hearing their own voice in the wires, they are late. Half the village is. The other half sells the wires.

breather.gist: The underpass will kill them prettily. You sell the ugly breather that keeps them alive: sixteen scrip.

knife.gist: Ceramic knife, ten scrip. Pike and the pit both respect an edge more than a speech.

village.gist: Dock, market, chapel, yard, clinic. South of Pike is where the map starts lying. You do not discount lies.

spire.gist: The Spire wants two metals and a word. You sell neither. You sell the walk.

combat.onDeathSay: The market goes quiet the way a village does when it will remember your face. Mare's stock spills into the mud. You can take it. You will not be thanked.
